title: TOCALib: Optimal control library with interpolation for bimanual manipulation and obstacles avoidance
title_zh: TOCALib：面向双臂操作与避障的最优控制插值库
abstract: The paper presents a new approach for constructing a library of optimal trajectories for two robotic manipulators, Two-Arm Optimal Control and Avoidance Library (TOCALib)1. The optimization takes into account kinodynamic and other constraints within the FROST framework. The novelty of the method lies in the consideration of collisions using the DCOL method, which allows obtaining symbolic expressions for assessing the presence of collisions and using them in gradient-based optimization control methods. The proposed approach is applicable for complex bimanual manipulations that require precision. In this paper we tested TOCALib on Mobile Aloha robot, as an example. The approach can be extended to other bimanual robots, as well as to gait control of bipedal robots. It can also be used to construct training data for machine learning tasks for manipulation.
abstract_zh: 本文提出了一种为两个机械臂构建最优轨迹库的新方法，即双臂最优控制与避障库（TOCALib）。该优化在FROST框架内考虑了运动动力学及其他约束。该方法的新颖之处在于使用DCOL方法处理碰撞，从而获得评估碰撞是否发生的符号表达式，并将其用于基于梯度的优化控制方法中。所提方法适用于需要高精度的复杂双臂操作。本文以Mobile Aloha机器人为例对TOCALib进行了测试。该方法可扩展到其他双臂机器人，以及双足机器人的步态控制。它还可用于为操作任务的机器学习构建训练数据。
tldr_zh: 提出TOCALib库，用DCOL符号碰撞检测优化双臂轨迹，在Mobile Aloha上验证。
cover_zh: 双臂机器人避障还能这么玩？符号碰撞检测让优化直接起飞
